name: Create a fullscreen color-field pattern with image and right content area
query: Create a full-width pattern with a solid color field, a large image on the left, and a right content column with italic uppercase heading, italic description, and a filled CTA.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route to wp-patterns and confirm asset, color presets, text domain, and pattern metadata
Step 2: Use Cover or Group with a solid background color and block-native flex/wrap layout
Step 3: Place the image and content in an asymmetric layout that stacks on mobile
Step 4: Use italic display typography and a short description without sacrificing readability
Step 5: Add a filled CTA with action-specific label
Step 6: Escape/i18n all strings and handle image alt text intentionally
Step 7: Verify mobile stacking, contrast, and editor parsing
success_criteria: Composition uses a large image plus a right content area over a strong color field
Typography treatment is distinctive but readable
Image uses local/approved asset and appropriate alt handling
Uses block-native layout and presets where possible
Avoids scripts, inline style tags, and custom CSS classes
